compared.claim: doi:10.5802/ahl.16:prop:OSRamsey, the statement at lines 368-374 whose equivalent forms the same proof invokes
compared.difference: This card's statement is the fixed point criterion for the spectrum of a left-invariant algebra, an analytic statement; the neighbouring proposition is the purely combinatorial equivalence between finite oscillation stability of a finite set of colorings and the existence of copies on which they are constant. The proof uses the latter as an input and does not reproduce it, so the two are not interderivable and the neighbouring statement stays a navigation pointer.

The gate returned RESULT=OK; its manual-review note about a further proof environment starting at line 390 concerns the separate block that proves the next theorem, not this card's proof, which is closed at line 388.
